headline: Detailed per-region rule reference for owner: 3 separate docs (MB, MN, MT) covering all 7 weekdays each with active stations, per-station hit-rate breakdown (which station contributes most), 3 most-recent worked examples per rule, BH-pass classification (268 gold-standard cells out of 3,696 unique combinations). 35 best BH-pass cells in 90-day forward audit (anchor 2026-06-02, closeout 2026-08-31).
